metas.name: Thazhvaram
metas.description: A man comes to an isolated valley to take revenge on his friend who murdered his wife.

metas.name: Aakrosam
metas.description: A police officer attempts to change a dacoit into a good person and also gets him married to a beautiful village girl. However, circumstances do not let the changed man live happily.

metas.name: Adima Changala
metas.description: The film is a remake of the 1969 Italian zapata Spaghetti Western film The Five Man Army.
